headline: Dabur India Limited: Scheme of Arrangement – NCLT Order Reserved for Second Motion Petition
sum: NCLT New Delhi reserves order on second motion petition in the scheme of amalgamation between Sesa Care Private Limited and Dabur India Limited. The tribunal has deferred final ruling, signalling ongoing judicial review of merger conditions and stakeholder objections.
implication: Scheme approval remains in abeyance pending NCLT determination on procedural/substantive grounds raised in second motion; amalgamation structure contingent on tribunal's interpretation of Companies Act 2013 s.230–232 merger thresholds and creditor/minority protections.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), New Delhi Bench, has reserved its order on a second motion petition filed in the scheme of amalgamation between Sesa Care Private Limited (the transferor) and Dabur India Limited (the transferee). The Scheme seeks to merge Sesa Care into Dabur India. By reserving the order, NCLT has indicated it will deliver a reasoned judgment addressing substantive or procedural objections raised in the second motion, likely pertaining to shareholder sanction, creditor claims, or regulatory compliance under the Companies Act 2013 merger framework. The status remains 'review' pending the tribunal's ruling.
